items.title: A finite type module with proper support is universally pure, and a proper morphism gives universal purity
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a finite type module whose support is proper over the base is universally pure, and in particular that a proper morphism makes a finite type module, and the scheme itself, universally pure (statement lines 5015-5026, tag 05L3-adjacent). The proof reduces the first part to the case of a proper morphism by factoring the module through its support and then rules out impurities by universal closedness of a proper morphism. The contradiction argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
